meaning: The place's id in district_counts/sites.csv (`place`); `archive:<id>` for an archive row with no pin, which sites.csv does not hold.
The name of the most authoritative record: archive, then Wikidata, OSM (tier A, B, C), DOAM, GeoNames.
Every other distinct name the place's records give, separated by `; `.
First stated tradition in the same order (muslim, hindu, sikh, jain, secular, other, unknown).

What the place is. From the existence check's evidence where it named a kind; else the archive's category and site_type; else the source's tradition (`muslim_tomb_or_shrine` when a source says only muslim). A name or evidence quote saying Buddhist, stupa, monastery, church, cathedral or Marian makes it `buddhist_or_christian_out_of_scope`. `note` says which.
Latitude of the most precise source's point, unchanged. Empty for an unpinned archive row.
Longitude, as lat.
Which source the point is: archive, then wikidata, osm, doam; geonames only when it is the only source.
District code of the point's record.
Province of that district.
verified / archive_documented / doam_documented / web_confirmed / plausible / unconfirmed / contradicted; rules in README.md.
Number of distinct sources among archive, doam, osm, wikidata, geonames (OSM tiers count once).
Those sources, `; ` separated.
Every record as `source:id`, OSM with its tier in brackets.
Each non-archive record's own page.
The archive row's id when the archive records the place.
That row's support_level.
The existence check's verdict for a one-source place (confirmed / plausible / no_evidence / contradicted), after its quote checks and the hand spot check; empty when not checked.
The outside pages the verdict rests on, `; ` separated. Never the record's own page.
Word-for-word quotes from those pages' titles or snippets, ` | ` separated.
yes when tier is verified, archive_documented, doam_documented or web_confirmed and kind is not secular_tomb_or_memorial, mosque_only, graveyard or buddhist_or_christian_out_of_scope.
Where kind came from, and anything a reader must know about the row.
